condition.narrative: Environmental and Social Commitment Plan: Monthly reporting for contracted work throughout contract/sub-contract period should besubmitted to the PIU within 15 days after the end of the period, from the first month of engagement.

Environmental and Social Commitment Plan: Notify the Bank immediately of any incident or accident within 48 hours after becomingaware of the incident or accident, followed by a detailed report on the incident within the timeframe established by the Bankfollowing the initial notification
Environmental and Social Commitment Plan: Project's GRM to be prepared no later than two months after project's effectiveness

Environmental and Social Commitment Plan: Security Risk Assessment and Security Management Plan to be prepared prior to activitiesimplementation in Far North, North West, and South West regions and prior to any procurement/RFP of activities in these regions
Environmental and Social Commitment Plan: Specific IPP (s) to be prepared no later than two months after the Effective Date

Environmental and Social Commitment Plan: The Recipient shall submit monitoring reports on the environmental, social, health andsafety (ESHS) performance of the Project quarterly throughout the Project implementation period, starting 3 months after theEffective Date, to be submitted within 30 days after the end of the period

Section I.A.1 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: The Recipient shall hire within 90 days from the Effective Date anenvironmental specialist and a social specialist, a GBV specialist, a monitoring and evaluation specialist, a communicationsspecialist, an agriculture manager, an information and communications technologies (ICT) manager, and an e-voucher advisor

Section I.A.1 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: The Recipient shall maintain throughout the implementation of the Project, andvest onto it the day-to-day Project implementation responsibilities, a Project Implementation Unit (PIU) within MINPOSTEL, withfunctions, responsibilities, resources and composition satisfactory to the Association, as set forth in the Project ImplementationManual, including at a minimum: a Project coordinator, a procurement specialist, a financial management specialist, and anaccountant

Section I.A.2 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: No later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, the Recipient shallestablish and maintain throughout the implementation of the Project, a Project Steering Committee, to provide strategic guidance tothe PIU, and to approve Annual Work Plans and Budgets, which shall be chaired by MINPOSTEL, and include high-level representativesof inter alia, the office of the President of the Recipient, the office of the Prime Minister of the Recipient, MINEPAT; MINEPIA;MINADER; MINFI, MINDDEVEL, ART, ANTIC, CAA, a selected digital consumer association, and others as necessary, as further providedin the PIM.

Section I.A.3 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: No later than 30 days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall establishand maintain two Technical Committees to provide technical guidance to the PIU , and shall include technical experts from theministries involved as well as representatives from national and regional entities such as telecom operators and internet serviceproviders, local agritech entrepreneurs, farmer groups, academia and local governments, as appropriate. The ICT Technical Committeeshall be chaired by MINPOSTEL, and the Agricultural Technical Committee shall be chaired by MINADER and MINEPIA

Section I.B.2 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: Prior to implementing Part 2.1(c) of the Project, the Recipient shall, prepare,in accordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Association, a public-private partnership manual (“PPP Manual")

Section I.B.3 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: Prior to implementing Part 3.2 of the Project, the Recipient shall prepare andadopt an E-Vouchers manual, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association, to be annexed to the PIM as soon as adopted, andgiving details of the guidelines and procedures governing E-Vouchers

Section I.B.4 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: The Recipient shall prepare and adopt a matching grants manual, (the “MGManual”) in form and substance satisfactory to the Association and giving details of the guidelines and procedures governingMatching Grants

Section I.D.2 of Schedule 2 to the Legal Agreement: Prior to carrying out of Part 2.2(b) of the Project, the Recipient shall enterinto one or more, as applicable, operator's contracts with one or more, as applicable, Selected Operators in accordance with theprovisions of Section 5.13 of the General Conditions under terms and conditions approved by the Association for such purpose (eacha “CAPEX Subsidies Agreement”).

Section I.E.1 of Schedule 2 of the Legal Agreement: No later than 180 days from the Effective Date, the Recipient, throughMINPOSTEL, shall recruit, appoint, and thereafter maintain the Voucher Management Agency (VMA) on terms of reference and with staffand functions acceptable to the Association, to facilitate the implementation of Part 3.2 of the Project
